name: Repeat the pig cardiomyocyte-proliferation experiment with transient delivery and full cause-of-death reporting

design.intervention: miR-199a or an equivalent proliferative signal delivered as mRNA or from a self-limiting vector
design.readout: cardiac MRI function, cardiomyocyte proliferation index, telemetry, survival with necropsy-confirmed cause of death for every animal

discriminates: Function recovered with survival under transient delivery would make controllable proliferation a live route; deaths under both delivery modes would indicate the proliferative state itself is the hazard.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
